messages:
emma: Heads-up: weve GA'd aurora-stream-1 for Hosted API. It unlocks streaming with tool-calling and an updated client contract. Rolling out next week; migration docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/aurora-stream.
mike: any delta from the beta in terms of chunk format or framing?
emma: chunk format is stable, but we've tightened event typing: tool_call events now include tool_id and tool_schema fields. Also weve reduced initial-response latency by ~20% on average.
lena: note for infra teams: default route config now exposes max_stream_duration=180s and session_keepalive to 30s. If you rely on 300s streams, set max_stream_duration explicitly in the route.
mike: example curl for streaming + tool-calls?
emma: ```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Redwood-Stream-Version: aurora-v1" -d '{"model":"aurora-stream-1","input":"Find flights to SFO","enable_tool_calls":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/stream
```
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: canary 1792035700 -> 5% traffic in eu-west-1 on 2026-05-05, monitor window 72h.
emma: rollout plan: canary 5% -> monitor 72h -> 25% -> monitor 7d -> full. Hosted customers auto-upgrade, opt-out available for 48h via org settings during canary.
lena: docs-bot: migration checklist published: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/aurora-stream#migration (includes SDK patches, curl snippets, and backwards compatibility notes).
mike: are other endpoints affected? embeddings / sync generate?
emma: No, only the new aurora-stream surface. Non-realtime endpoints unchanged.
lena: ops ask: please update any internal SDKs to handle tool_schema in tool_call events; SDK PRs are queued in repo infra/stream-sdks.
emma: thanks all 8640; ping me for early canary access or if you want traffic split adjustments.
mike: congrats team! :tada:
